abstract_sentences.text: We introduce Generative Universal Verifier, a novel concept and plugin designed for next-generation multimodal reasoning in vision-language models and unified multimodal models, providing the fundamental capability of reflection and refinement on visual outcomes during the reasoning and generation process.

evidence.anchor: fundamental capability of reflection and refinement

abstract_sentences.text: This work makes three main contributions: (1) We build ViVerBench, a comprehensive benchmark spanning 16 categories of critical tasks for evaluating visual outcomes in multimodal reasoning.

evidence.anchor: benchmark spanning 16 categories

abstract_sentences.text: Results show that existing VLMs consistently underperform across these tasks, underscoring a substantial gap from human-level capability in reliable visual verification.

evidence.anchor: existing VLMs consistently underperform

abstract_sentences.text: (2) We design two automated pipelines to construct large-scale visual verification data and train OmniVerifier-7B, the first omni-capable generative verifier trained for universal visual verification and achieves notable gains on ViVerBench (+8.3).

evidence.anchor: two automated pipelines and ViVerBench(+8.3)

abstract_sentences.text: Through training, we identify three atomic capabilities in visual verification and demonstrate how they generalize and interact synergistically.

evidence.anchor: three atomic capabilities

abstract_sentences.text: (3) We propose OmniVerifier-TTS, a sequential test-time scaling paradigm that leverages the universal verifier to bridge image generation and editing within unified models, enhancing the upper bound of generative ability through iterative fine-grained optimization.

evidence.anchor: bridge image generation and editing

abstract_sentences.text: Beyond generation, we extend universal verifier to broader world-modeling interleaved reasoning scenarios.

evidence.anchor: broader world-modeling interleaved reasoning scenarios

abstract_sentences.text: Empirically, OmniVerifier-TTS achieves improvements on T2I-ReasonBench (+3.7), and GenEval++ (+4.3), outperforming existing parallel test-time scaling methods, such as Best-of-N.

evidence.anchor: T2I-ReasonBench(+3.7) and GenEval++(+4.3)

abstract_sentences.text: By endowing multimodal reasoning with reliable visual verification, OmniVerifier advances both reliable reflection during generation and scalable test-time refinement, marking a step toward more trustworthy and controllable next-generation reasoning systems.

evidence.anchor: more trustworthy and controllable
evolving from simple image understanding to complex visual reasoning

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 visual-outcome verification 做成可生成 explanation/edit prompt 的 verifier，再用它驱动 UMM 的 sequential image refinement；ViVerBench 暴露缺口，atomic-capability transfer 缩小训练空间，OmniVerifier-TTS 把验证接回生成闭环。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 ViVerBench 与 Table 1、两条数据 pipeline、capability 发现、TTS 闭环图以及 Table 2–3，足以让读者理解方法与主要决策。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载逐任务定义、专家流程、评测公式、额外 benchmark、效率轮数、Gemini verifier、成功/失败图像、LongCoT、完整 prompts 和限制披露。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 5 将 false → explanation → edit → true 的中间状态显式串起，Figure 3/4 再把 transfer 结果组织成 capability map。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 点 accuracy、定性案例与 upper-bound/guarantee 语言之间缺少 seed 方差、显著性、prompt-level 分布、wall-clock 成本和 formal guarantee；负向 transfer 与 Figure 9 失败证据也后置。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对于验证后修正系统，正文同时展示错误判定、修正动作、修正后的终点和同预算效率对照；最终质量单独不足以证明闭环起作用。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于存在可观察中间状态、局部修正动作和独立 outcome 判定的生成/推理系统；domain gap 大或 judge 不可靠时仍需 task-specific data 与机制检验。

abstract_summary.function_sequence: object_scope/core_idea → problem_gap/method → qualitative_result → method/quantitative_result → core_idea/qualitative_result → core_idea/method → method/impact_claim → quantitative_result → impact_claim

introduction_summary.move_sequence: context → problem → missing_insight → method_preview → result_preview → method_preview → result_preview → method_preview → result_preview → contribution_list
introduction_summary.falsifiable_claims_in_list: The list repeats 8.3-point improvement and higher/lower TTS performance, but omits uncertainty and stopping criteria.

related_work_summary.later_argument_reuse: References mainly establish the field gap; later sections do not systematically return to individual citation clusters for controlled comparison.

method_summary.core_objects: ViVerBench, two data construction pipelines, DAPO RL on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, three atomic capabilities, OmniVerifier-7B and OmniVerifier-TTS.
method_summary.inputs_outputs: Image/prompt pairs or image-plus-prompt verification inputs produce true/false, explanation and optionally edit prompt; UMM consumes edit prompt to produce a refined image.
method_summary.state_problem: High-dimensional visual outcomes and fine-grained alignment errors are hard to verify; integrative tasks have domain-specific reasoning patterns.
method_summary.formal_assumptions: No formal theorem assumptions; Appendix A.3 defines only rule-based/model-based evaluation conditions.
method_summary.algorithm_count: No numbered pseudocode algorithms; Figure 2 and Figure 5 are flow diagrams.
method_summary.theory_role: No theory module; the two metric equations are diagnostic/core-chain evaluation definitions in the appendix.

statistics_summary.aggregation_unit: Per-task ViVerBench sample for rule-based accuracy; benchmark-level overall scores; mean refinement rounds; macro average in VL-RewardBench.
statistics_summary.denominators: N samples per task in Eq. (1)/(2); no per-task N values in the main tables.
statistics_summary.center_and_dispersion: Point accuracies, overall scores and mean rounds; no standard deviation or interval.
statistics_summary.seed_task_dataset_participant_levels: Task and benchmark levels visible; seed, prompt and participant dispersion unavailable.
statistics_summary.decision_quantities: Accuracy, overall score, macro average, mean refinement rounds and reported absolute deltas.
statistics_summary.figure_caption_independence: Captions name task/strategy but cannot independently reconstruct sample size, uncertainty or cost.

appendix_summary.main_text_calls: Explicit calls target Appendix A for definitions/curation/evaluation; most B–J sections are not called by number from the main body.
appendix_summary.claims_dependent_on_appendix: Exact task prompts, expert protocol, metric equations, efficiency rounds, Gemini ceiling and limitations/failure examples.
appendix_summary.missing_from_appendix: random seeds, complete optimization schedule, split/leakage protocol, uncertainty and wall-clock cost.
